reason: The reduced-motion guard (helpers/_motion.css). P has no prefers-reduced-motion block. Its selectors are [style]:is([style*="--anim:"], ...) because the kit's props are !important at (0,1,0) and the guard needs (0,2,0) to win from any place in the sheet. It stops --anim in every tier, the --tn/--tdn/--tp transition props, and the helpers' `transition: var(--transition)` in both families (-hvr and -hover).

Writing direction for @keyframes st-slide-in (helpers/_motion.css). Keyframes cannot take logical directions, so they read --st-dir: 1 by default, -1 inside an RTL subtree, which makes the slide start at the inline end.
